proposed_capability: P95 design one opt-in bounded household upkeep polling/advisory seam: Servo four-motive health and eligible helper Tune Up/Recharge queue proposals plus observed household bill lifecycle and affordable pay-bill queue proposal. P124 integrate through existing host_stack and host_listener, queue_capacity and budget owners; no new daemon or input owner. Trifecta P82 offline adversarial tests, P07 integration, P08 exact local Sims runtime proof.
player_save_control_impact: No changes to game files or saves, household Build/Buy or purchases, no EA internet, no automatic mouse or keyboard inputs, no replacement of explicit player queue; bills paid only if an explicitly admitted session authorizes in-game bill payment and current unpaid+funds+UI evidence exists.
expected_outcome: Each explicit host observation monitors every observed Servo's four special needs and bill state; a critical Servo gets a freshly observed eligible helper Tune Up or self recharge proposal, and a due bill gets a verified pay-bills proposal if affordable. A single proposal at a time, no duplicate queue, no rerun after unverified dispatch, periodic bounded reobservation, and existing survival/player/viewport/career/gardening priorities remain intact.
negative_tests: Servo without verified four needs cannot be treated as a human Sim with six needs
Critical Servo low durability and charge choose safe eligible observed helper, no self-maintenance assumptions
Insufficient/unknown supplies or unavailable helper yields inspect or hold; never buys parts
Multiple household Servos monitored with bounded rows and one selected proposal
Unpaid bill amount and sufficient observed simoleon funds required; paid/unknown or insufficient funds never queues payment
Bill attempt QUEUED/DISPATCHED prevents duplicate; payout requires independently verified paid receipt
Existing player/scene/viewport/build-mode, urgent human needs, already busy, stale capture and queue full are never bypassed
No new daemon, no per-frame scanning, no input authority; existing listener without new input unchanged
rollback_path: Revert isolated PR; preserve game, saves, previously certified profiles and existing host-stack signatures for absent input.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact active Sims 4 build, local Servo eligible menu action, robotics requirements, water exposure, live bills UI/payment confirmation and actual queue persistence require Windows host observation
P08 live certification cannot be obtained from GitHub CI; this cloud lane creates evaluators and tests only
